title: Ugly Love
author: Colleen Hoover
description: A heart-wrenching love story that explores the complexities of relationships and the power of love to heal even the deepest wounds.
quote: Love is not always pretty, but it's worth fighting for.

title: Verity
author: Colleen Hoover
description: A gripping psychological thriller that delves into the dark secrets of a bestselling author, blurring the lines between fiction and reality.
quote: The truth is often more complicated than the lies we tell ourselves.

title: A Song Of Ice And Fire
author: George R.R. Martin
description: An epic fantasy series that weaves together political intrigue, complex characters, and a richly detailed world filled with magic and danger.
quote: A song of ice and fire, a tale of two houses, a story of love and loss.

title: A Court of Thorns and Roses
author: Sarah J. Maas
description: When nineteen-year-old Feyre kills a wolf in the woods, a terrifying creature arrives to demand retribution. Taken to a magical land ruled by faeries, she discovers her captor is far more than he appears.
quote: Don't feel bad for one moment about doing what brings you joy.

title: Six of Crows
author: Leigh Bardugo
description: A thrilling fantasy heist novel set in the bustling city of Ketterdam. Criminal prodigy Kaz Brekker assembles a crew of six dangerous outcasts to attempt an impossible heist.
quote: No mourners. No funerals.

title: The Shining
author: Stephen King
description: A chilling horror novel that follows the story of a family staying in an isolated hotel during the winter, where supernatural forces threaten to drive them to madness.
quote: We all go a little mad sometimes.

title: Chapterhouse: Dune
author: Frank Herbert
description: The sixth novel in the Dune series, continuing the epic saga of political intrigue, religious conflict, and ecological struggle on the desert planet of Arrakis.
quote: The most dangerous place on Earth is the center of it.

title: Journey to the Center of the Earth
author: Jules Verne
description: A thrilling adventure novel that takes readers on a journey to the center of the Earth, filled with danger, discovery, and excitement.
quote: Science is the captain, and practice the soldier.

title: It Ends with Us
author: Colleen Hoover
description: A brave and heartbreaking novel that digs into the realness of abuse and the courage it takes to end a cycle that has been going on for generations.
quote: Just because someone hurts you doesn't mean you can simply stop loving them.

title: November 9
author: Colleen Hoover
description: Two strangers connect on the same date each year over five years, navigating love, loss, and secrets that could destroy them both.
quote: The most important thing about art is that we feel it.

title: Normal People
author: Sally Rooney
description: A story of two young Irish people who are drawn together by an attraction neither can resist, a bond that changes everything.
quote: In the future I might regret my decision, but I will also regret it if I don't.

title: Conversations with Friends
author: Sally Rooney
description: Frances is twenty-one years old and studying in Dublin. She and her best friend Bobbi perform spoken word poetry together, and one night they are introduced to a well-known journalist named Melissa.
quote: I was so unused to saying things out loud that actually mattered to me.

title: The Fault in Our Stars
author: John Green
description: A love story between two teenagers who meet at a cancer support group and fall in love despite knowing their time together may be short.
quote: You gave me a forever within the numbered days.

title: Me Before You
author: Jojo Moyes
description: Louisa Clark is an ordinary girl living a small life until she takes a job caring for Will Traynor, a wealthy man who has become paralyzed after an accident.
quote: You only get one life. It's actually your duty to live it as fully as possible.

title: The Notebook
author: Nicholas Sparks
description: A love story about a man who reads to a woman from a faded notebook, telling the story of two young lovers separated by circumstance.
quote: I am nothing special, of this I am sure. I am a common man with common thoughts.

title: A Walk to Remember
author: Nicholas Sparks
description: A tale of two very different teenagers who are thrown together in unexpected ways, leading to a story that will stay with you for life.
quote: Love is like the wind, you can't see it but you can feel it.

title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
description: One of the most beloved novels in the English language, telling the story of the witty and independent Elizabeth Bennet and the proud Mr. Darcy.
quote: It is a truth universally acknowledged, that a single man in possession of a good fortune, must be in want of a wife.

title: Sense and Sensibility
author: Jane Austen
description: The story of the Dashwood sisters navigating life, love, and society with contrasting approaches of sense and sensibility.
quote: Know your own happiness. Want for nothing but patience.

title: Emma
author: Jane Austen
description: A young woman matchmaker makes everyone's romantic matches except her own, leading to comic misunderstandings and eventual self-discovery.
quote: There is one thing I want to ask you. Will you be the friend of my happiness?

title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
author: Gabriel García Márquez
description: A multi-generational saga of the Buendía family in the fictional town of Macondo, blending magical realism with profound social commentary.
quote: He was still too young to know that the heart's memory eliminates the bad and magnifies the good.

title: The Alchemist
author: Paulo Coelho
description: A philosophical novel about a young Andalusian shepherd who dreams of finding worldly treasure and travels to the Egyptian pyramids to find it.
quote: And, when you want something, all the universe conspires in helping you to achieve it.

title: Crime and Punishment
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
description: A psychological drama about a young student who murders a pawnbroker and grapples with the moral consequences of his actions.
quote: Pain and suffering are always inevitable for a large intelligence and a deep heart.

title: Norwegian Wood
author: Haruki Murakami
description: A nostalgic story of loss and sexuality set in Tokyo during the late 1960s, following student Toru Watanabe as he recalls his first love and the heartbreak that followed.
quote: If you only read the books that everyone else is reading, you can only think what everyone else is thinking.

title: Kafka on the Shore
author: Haruki Murakami
description: A boy runs away from home and an old man who can talk to cats are on parallel journeys that will intersect in mysterious and magical ways.
quote: Memories warm you up from the inside. But they also tear you apart.

title: Beloved
author: Toni Morrison
description: A former enslaved woman is haunted by the ghost of her dead daughter in post-Civil War Ohio, in a searing exploration of memory, trauma, and freedom.
quote: She is a friend of my mind. She gather me, man. The pieces I am, she gather them and give them back to me in all the right order.

title: The Bluest Eye
author: Toni Morrison
description: A young Black girl in 1940s Ohio prays for blue eyes, believing it will make her beautiful and loved, in a devastating portrait of racism and self-hatred.
quote: Love is never any better than the lover.

title: The Metamorphosis
author: Franz Kafka
description: A salesman wakes one morning to find himself transformed into a giant insect, and his family must adapt to their new reality in this surreal masterpiece.
quote: I cannot make you understand. I cannot make anyone understand what is happening inside me. I cannot even explain it to myself.

title: The Trial
author: Franz Kafka
description: Josef K. is arrested and prosecuted by a mysterious authority for a crime that is never revealed, in Kafka's haunting parable of modern bureaucracy.
quote: Someone must have slandered Josef K., for one morning, without having done anything wrong, he was arrested.

title: Mrs Dalloway
author: Virginia Woolf
description: Over the course of a single day in post-WWI London, Clarissa Dalloway prepares for a party while a shell-shocked war veteran struggles with his memories.
quote: She would not say of anyone in the world now that they were this or were that.

title: To the Lighthouse
author: Virginia Woolf
description: The Ramsay family's visits to their summer home on the Isle of Skye are separated by a decade and shaped by the shadow of World War One.
quote: The great revelation had never come. The great revelation perhaps never did come. Instead there were little daily miracles.

title: A Tale of Two Cities
author: Charles Dickens
description: Set against the backdrop of the French Revolution, this novel of love and sacrifice follows characters in London and Paris during the Reign of Terror.
quote: It was the best of times, it was the worst of times.

title: Great Expectations
author: Charles Dickens
description: Young Pip's life is transformed when a mysterious benefactor funds his rise from humble origins to London gentleman, in Dickens's most beloved novel.
quote: Suffering has been stronger than all other teaching, and has taught me to understand what your heart used to be.

title: War and Peace
author: Leo Tolstoy
description: An epic novel of Russian society during the Napoleonic Wars, following five aristocratic families as history sweeps through their lives.
quote: The two most powerful warriors are patience and time.

title: Anna Karenina
author: Leo Tolstoy
description: A Russian aristocrat abandons her husband and son for a passionate affair with Count Vronsky, with tragic consequences in imperial Russia.
quote: All happy families are alike; each unhappy family is unhappy in its own way.

title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
author: Oscar Wilde
description: A beautiful young man sells his soul to remain forever young while his portrait ages and bears the mark of his corruption and moral depravity.
quote: The only way to get rid of a temptation is to yield to it.

title: The Stranger
author: Albert Camus
description: Meursault, a French Algerian, kills an Arab man and faces trial — not for the murder but for his emotional detachment, in this landmark existentialist novel.
quote: Mother died today. Or maybe yesterday; I can't be sure.

title: The Plague
author: Albert Camus
description: A plague sweeps through the Algerian city of Oran and a group of people must find meaning and purpose in the face of collective suffering.
quote: The absurd is the essential concept and the first truth.

title: Les Misérables
author: Victor Hugo
description: Ex-convict Jean Valjean is pursued across decades by the relentless Inspector Javert in this sweeping epic of justice, revolution, and redemption in 19th-century France.
quote: Even the darkest night will end and the sun will rise.

title: The Hunchback of Notre-Dame
author: Victor Hugo
description: The deformed bell-ringer Quasimodo falls in love with the beautiful gypsy Esmeralda in medieval Paris, in Hugo's tragic tale of beauty, prejudice, and fate.
quote: He who opens a school door, closes a prison.

title: The Divine Comedy
author: Dante Alighieri
description: Dante's journey through Hell, Purgatory, and Heaven guided by Virgil and Beatrice, the supreme work of Italian literature and a cornerstone of world literature.
quote: Abandon all hope, ye who enter here.

title: The Odyssey
author: Homer
description: The epic journey of Odysseus as he struggles to return home after the fall of Troy, facing monsters, gods, and temptation over ten years at sea.
quote: Of all creatures that breathe and move upon the earth, nothing is bred that is weaker than man.

title: Hamlet
author: William Shakespeare
description: Prince Hamlet is visited by his father's ghost and tasked with avenging his murder, in Shakespeare's greatest tragedy of revenge, madness, and mortality.
quote: To be, or not to be, that is the question.

title: In Search of Lost Time
author: Marcel Proust
description: The longest novel in world literature, tracing the narrator's memories of childhood and experiences in Parisian high society through the power of involuntary memory.
quote: Remembrance of things past is not necessarily the remembrance of things as they were.

title: Ficciones
author: Jorge Luis Borges
description: A collection of short stories that blur the boundaries between fiction and essay, exploring labyrinths, infinite libraries, and the nature of reality.
quote: I have always imagined that Paradise will be a kind of library.

title: Madame Bovary
author: Gustave Flaubert
description: A provincial doctor's wife dreams of romance and luxury beyond her dull life, pursuing affairs and accumulating debts with tragic consequences.
quote: She wanted to die, but she also wanted to live in Paris.

title: Siddhartha
author: Hermann Hesse
description: A young Indian man leaves his wealthy family to seek spiritual enlightenment, journeying through asceticism, sensuality, and ultimately wisdom.
quote: Wisdom cannot be imparted. Wisdom that a wise man attempts to impart always sounds like foolishness to someone else.

title: Steppenwolf
author: Hermann Hesse
description: A middle-aged man who feels himself to be half-human and half-wolf embarks on a journey of self-discovery through the dark underbelly of 1920s Germany.
quote: I believe that the struggle against death, the unconditional and self-willed determination to live, is the motive power behind the lives and activities of all outstanding men.

title: Things Fall Apart
author: Chinua Achebe
description: The story of Okonkwo, a proud Igbo warrior, and the destruction of his world by the arrival of European missionaries and colonial government in Nigeria.
quote: When the moon is shining the cripple becomes hungry for a walk.

title: The Masnavi
author: Rumi
description: The greatest masterpiece of Sufi poetry, a vast collection of spiritual teaching stories and mystical verse exploring the soul's longing for union with the divine.
quote: Out beyond ideas of wrongdoing and rightdoing, there is a field. I'll meet you there.

title: The Cherry Orchard
author: Anton Chekhov
description: An aristocratic Russian family returns to their estate, including a cherry orchard, only to find that they must sell it to pay their debts in this timeless tragicomedy.
quote: When a lot of remedies are suggested for a disease, that means it cannot be cured.

title: Ulysses
author: James Joyce
description: The events of a single day in Dublin on June 16, 1904, following Leopold Bloom in a modern parallel to Homer's Odyssey, revolutionizing the form of the novel.
quote: Think you're escaping and run into yourself. Longest way round is the shortest way home.

title: Gitanjali
author: Rabindranath Tagore
description: A collection of 103 devotional poems by the Nobel Prize-winning Indian poet, expressing a deeply personal relationship between the human soul and the divine.
quote: Faith is the bird that feels the light when the dawn is still dark.

title: The Master and Margarita
author: Mikhail Bulgakov
description: The Devil visits Soviet Moscow accompanied by a retinue of odd characters, wreaking havoc, while in a parallel story Pontius Pilate confronts Jesus of Nazareth.
quote: Cowardice is the greatest sin.

title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
description: In the Jazz Age on Long Island, the mysterious millionaire Jay Gatsby pursues his dream of recapturing his past love for the beautiful Daisy Buchanan.
quote: So we beat on, boats against the current, borne back ceaselessly into the past.

title: The Grapes of Wrath
author: John Steinbeck
description: The Joad family, driven from their Oklahoma home by drought and economic hardship, journey to California in search of a better life during the Great Depression.
quote: And this I believe: that the free, exploring mind of the individual human is the most valuable thing in the world.

title: Of Mice and Men
author: John Steinbeck
description: Two displaced ranch workers dream of owning their own land in Depression-era California, but their dreams are threatened by circumstance and tragedy.
quote: A guy needs somebody to be near him. A guy goes nuts if he ain't got nobody.

title: The Kite Runner
author: Khaled Hosseini
description: A privileged boy and the son of his father's servant grow up together in Kabul until a moment of betrayal tears them apart, with consequences that echo across decades.
quote: For you, a thousand times over.

title: A Thousand Splendid Suns
author: Khaled Hosseini
description: Two Afghan women from different generations are bound together by the brutality of the men in their lives and the devastating backdrop of Afghanistan's history.
quote: One could not count the moons that shimmer on her roofs, or the thousand splendid suns that hide behind her walls.

title: The Book Thief
author: Markus Zusak
description: Narrated by Death, the story of Liesel Meminger, a young girl in Nazi Germany who steals books and shares them with her neighbors during World War Two.
quote: I have hated words and I have loved them, and I hope I have made them right.

title: Midnight's Children
author: Salman Rushdie
description: A child born at the moment of India's independence discovers he is telepathically linked to all other children born in that midnight hour in this Booker Prize-winning novel.
quote: To understand just one life, you have to swallow the world.

title: Americanah
author: Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie
description: A young Nigerian woman travels to America for university and navigates race, identity, and love, while her childhood sweetheart takes a different path through England.
quote: Dear Non-American Black, when you make the choice to come to America, you become Black.

title: The Remains of the Day
author: Kazuo Ishiguro
description: An English butler takes a road trip and reflects on his years of service at Darlington Hall, confronting the choices he made in the name of professional dignity.
quote: It is, as I say, a most curious thing. But there we are.

title: The Namesake
author: Jhumpa Lahiri
description: The Ganguli family moves from Calcutta to Cambridge, Massachusetts, and their American-born son Gogol struggles with his unusual name and dual cultural identity.
quote: We all came out of Gogol's overcoat.

title: The House of the Spirits
author: Isabel Allende
description: Four generations of the Trueba family in Chile experience love, passion, and political upheaval in this sweeping saga blending magical realism with historical drama.
quote: We are what we remember.

title: The Name of the Rose
author: Umberto Eco
description: A Franciscan friar and his novice investigate a series of mysterious deaths at a medieval Italian abbey where access to a forbidden book may be the key to the murders.
quote: The order that our mind imagines is like a net, or like a ladder, built to attain something.

title: The Unbearable Lightness of Being
author: Milan Kundera
description: Two couples navigate love, sex, and politics in Prague during the 1968 Soviet invasion in this philosophical novel about the weight of our choices.
quote: The heaviest of burdens is therefore simultaneously an image of life's most intense fulfillment.

title: Blood Wedding
author: Gabriel García Lorca
description: On the day of a wedding in rural Spain, the bride runs away with a former lover, leading to a violent and tragic confrontation between two families.
quote: I want to be with you so that you can't close your eyes and see me.

title: Palace Walk
author: Naguib Mahfouz
description: The first volume of the Cairo Trilogy, following the patriarchal Al-Sayyid Ahmad Abd al-Jawad and his family in Cairo during the British occupation of Egypt.
quote: Nothing records the effects of a sad life so graphically as the human body.

title: The Hobbit
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: Bilbo Baggins is a hobbit who enjoys a comfortable life until a wizard and thirteen dwarves arrive and take him on an epic adventure to reclaim a treasure guarded by a dragon.
quote: In a hole in the ground there lived a hobbit.

title: The Fellowship of the Ring
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: The first part of The Lord of the Rings, where Frodo Baggins begins a perilous journey to destroy the One Ring and save Middle-earth.
quote: Not all those who wander are lost.

title: The Two Towers
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: The second part of The Lord of the Rings, following the Fellowship split across two epic story threads as the war for Middle-earth escalates.
quote: The world is indeed full of peril, and in it there are many dark places.

title: The Return of the King
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: The epic conclusion to The Lord of the Rings, in which the armies of the free peoples stand against the dark lord Sauron at the gates of Mordor.
quote: I will not say do not weep, for not all tears are an evil.

title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
author: J.K. Rowling
description: An orphan boy discovers he is a wizard and enrolls at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, where he uncovers a plot to steal a powerful stone.
quote: It does not do to dwell on dreams and forget to live.

title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
author: J.K. Rowling
description: Harry returns to Hogwarts for his second year to find the school under threat from a mysterious monster living in the Chamber of Secrets.
quote: It is our choices, Harry, that show what we truly are.

title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
author: J.K. Rowling
description: In his third year at Hogwarts, Harry discovers that a dangerous prisoner has escaped from Azkaban — a prisoner who may be connected to his own past.
quote: Happiness can be found even in the darkest of times, if only one remembers to turn on the light.

title: The Name of the Wind
author: Patrick Rothfuss
description: A legendary figure sits down with a chronicler and tells the story of how he became the most feared, powerful, and mysterious figure of his age.
quote: Words are pale shadows of forgotten names.

title: Mistborn: The Final Empire
author: Brandon Sanderson
description: In a world of ash and fog where the evil Lord Ruler has dominated for a thousand years, a young girl with strange powers joins a group of rebels.
quote: There is always another secret.

title: The Way of Kings
author: Brandon Sanderson
description: The first book in the Stormlight Archive, a monumental epic set in a world plagued by devastating storms and ancient dark forces.
quote: The most important step a man can take is not the first one, is it? It's the next one.

title: Good Omens
author: Terry Pratchett & Neil Gaiman
description: An angel and a demon have grown rather fond of Earth and its humans, and neither wants to see it End. Together they work to prevent Armageddon.
quote: God moves in extremely mysterious, not to say, circuitous ways.

title: American Gods
author: Neil Gaiman
description: A recently released ex-convict finds himself drawn into the company of gods and other mythical beings who have come to America with their worshippers.
quote: I believe that life is a game, that life is a cruel joke, and that life is what happens when you're alive.

title: The Night Circus
author: Erin Morgenstern
description: A mysterious circus arrives without warning and opens only at night. Two young magicians are trained as competitors, but fall in love instead.
quote: The finest of pleasures are always the unexpected ones.

title: Eragon
author: Christopher Paolini
description: A farm boy discovers a dragon's egg and becomes a Dragon Rider, uncovering a world of ancient magic and terrible evil in the land of Alagaësia.
quote: Walk in wisdom, Shadeslayer. Not all is as it seems.

title: The Lies of Locke Lamora
author: Scott Lynch
description: An orphan joins a secret society of thieves in a beautifully complex city and grows up to be one of the world's most sophisticated con artists.
quote: We're thieves in a world that doesn't want us. We steal what we can and try not to get caught.

title: Neverwhere
author: Neil Gaiman
description: When Richard Mayhew stops to help a mysterious injured girl, his normal life is plunged into the dark, strange world that exists beneath London.
quote: Richard had noticed that events were cowards — they didn't occur singly, but instead they would run in packs.

title: Crooked Kingdom
author: Leigh Bardugo
description: The sequel to Six of Crows — Kaz Brekker and his crew face their most dangerous mission yet as they try to outwit the world's most powerful players.
quote: Greed is your god, Kaz.

title: A Court of Mist and Fury
author: Sarah J. Maas
description: The harrowing sequel to A Court of Thorns and Roses, where Feyre must navigate a world of dangerous fae politics and forbidden magic.
quote: To the stars who listen, and the dreams that are answered.

title: From Blood and Ash
author: Jennifer L. Armentrout
description: A maiden chosen by the gods, raised in seclusion and bound by strict rules, falls for her forbidden guard and discovers truths that shatter her world.
quote: From blood and ash we will rise.

title: It
author: Stephen King
description: Seven adults return to Derry, Maine, where as teenagers they had defeated a terrifying creature called IT, and they must face it again.
quote: We all float down here.

title: Pet Sematary
author: Stephen King
description: The Creed family discovers an ancient burial ground behind their new home in Maine, where the dead return — but not as they were.
quote: Sometimes dead is better.

title: Dracula
author: Bram Stoker
description: The immortal vampire Count Dracula travels from Transylvania to England where he seeks new blood, while a small group of heroes try to stop him.
quote: We are in Transylvania; and Transylvania is not England.

title: Frankenstein
author: Mary Shelley
description: A young scientist creates a grotesque creature in an unorthodox scientific experiment, raising profound questions about creation, responsibility, and what it means to be human.
quote: Beware; for I am fearless, and therefore powerful.

title: The Haunting of Hill House
author: Shirley Jackson
description: Four people spend a summer at the mysterious Hill House, and one young woman's inner life begins to merge with the house's malevolent personality.
quote: No live organism can continue for long to exist sanely under conditions of absolute reality.

title: Bird Box
author: Josh Malerman
description: Something is out there, something terrifying that must not be seen. Malorie raises her two children in near-total darkness, keeping blindfolds on at all times.
quote: Most people ignored the news as it began to spread. By the time they understood, it was too late.

title: Mexican Gothic
author: Silvia Moreno-Garcia
description: A socialite travels to rescue her cousin from a remote mansion in 1950s Mexico, where she uncovers dark family secrets and ancient evil.
quote: She was not afraid of the dark, but she was afraid of what lived in it.

title: Salem's Lot
author: Stephen King
description: A writer returns to the small New England town of his childhood to find it slowly succumbing to a terrifying darkness.
quote: The town knew about darkness.

title: Misery
author: Stephen King
description: A novelist is rescued from a car crash by his self-proclaimed number one fan, only to become her prisoner in a remote Colorado farmhouse.
quote: I'm your number one fan.

title: Rebecca
author: Daphne du Maurier
description: A young woman marries a mysterious widower and moves to his grand estate, where the memory of his dead wife haunts every corner.
quote: Last night I dreamt I went to Manderley again.

title: Coraline
author: Neil Gaiman
description: A young girl walks through a door in her new home to find a parallel world with an "Other Mother" who seems perfect — but wants to sew buttons over her eyes.
quote: Fairy tales are more than true: not because they tell us that dragons exist, but because they tell us that dragons can be beaten.

title: Sharp Objects
author: Gillian Flynn
description: A journalist returns to her small hometown to report on the murders of two young girls, uncovering her own dark history in the process.
quote: I think there's a darkness in all of us.

title: House of Leaves
author: Mark Z. Danielewski
description: A family discovers their house is larger on the inside than the outside. As the family investigates this impossible phenomenon, dark secrets emerge.
quote: This is not for you.

title: Something Wicked This Way Comes
author: Ray Bradbury
description: Two boys discover that a mysterious carnival that has come to their small town is no ordinary attraction, but a dark and dangerous force.
quote: We are the creatures that know and know too much.

title: Rosemary's Baby
author: Ira Levin
description: A young woman suspects her friendly neighbours have a sinister interest in her unborn child in this landmark thriller.
quote: He chose you out of all the world.

title: Gone Girl
author: Gillian Flynn
description: On the morning of their fifth wedding anniversary, Nick Dunne's wife Amy disappears. Under pressure from the police and scrutiny of the media, Nick's portrait of a perfect union begins to crumble.
quote: We're so cute, I want to punch us in the face.

title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
author: Stieg Larsson
description: A journalist and a hacker investigate a decades-old disappearance in a wealthy Swedish family, uncovering a web of murder, fraud, and dark secrets.
quote: She had no need for men. They were only good for one thing, and even then there were better alternatives.

title: The Da Vinci Code
author: Dan Brown
description: A murder in the Louvre and clues in Da Vinci paintings lead to the discovery of a religious mystery that could shake the foundations of Christianity.
quote: Men go to far greater lengths to avoid what they fear than to obtain what they desire.

title: Big Little Lies
author: Liane Moriarty
description: Three women become entangled in lies about their seemingly perfect lives, leading up to a murder at the kindergarten school trivia night.
quote: Sometimes it's the smallest decisions that can change your life forever.

title: The Silent Patient
author: Alex Michaelides
description: A famous painter shoots her husband five times and then never speaks another word. A criminal psychotherapist is obsessed with uncovering her motive.
quote: My life has taught me one thing above all else: we never know what goes on behind closed doors.

title: The Girl on the Train
author: Paula Hawkins
description: A divorced woman becomes obsessed with a couple she sees from the train every day — until one day she witnesses something shocking.
quote: Hollowness: that I understand. I'm starting to believe that there isn't anything you can do about it.

title: In the Woods
author: Tana French
description: A detective investigates the murder of a young girl in the same woods where, twenty years ago, two children vanished and he himself was found with no memory.
quote: What I am telling you, before you begin my story, is this: I lied.

title: The Woman in the Window
author: A.J. Finn
description: An agoraphobic woman becomes obsessed with her new neighbours and believes she has witnessed something she was not supposed to see.
quote: I want to believe you. I want to, but I can't trust what I see anymore.

title: The Thursday Murder Club
author: Richard Osman
description: Four unlikely friends at a retirement village meet weekly to solve cold cases — until a real murder lands on their doorstep.
quote: There are many advantages to being eighty years old.

title: Behind Closed Doors
author: B.A. Paris
description: Everyone envies the perfect marriage of Jack and Grace Angel — but no one knows what goes on behind closed doors.
quote: Be careful what you wish for, because it might come true.

title: The 7½ Deaths of Evelyn Hardcastle
author: Stuart Turton
description: At a party, Evelyn Hardcastle will be murdered. The same events play out over and over — and the narrator must solve the mystery before time runs out.
quote: Happiness is a tide; it carries you to shore if you let it.

title: The Couple Next Door
author: Shari Lapena
description: A couple leaves their baby monitor running while attending a dinner party next door — and returns to find their baby missing.
quote: The truth is rarely simple.

title: Dune
author: Frank Herbert
description: Set in the distant future, a noble family assumes control of the desert planet Arrakis — the only source of the most valuable substance in the universe.
quote: I must not fear. Fear is the mind-killer.

title: Foundation
author: Isaac Asimov
description: A mathematician develops a science to predict the future and establishes a foundation to preserve human knowledge against the coming dark ages.
quote: Violence is the last refuge of the incompetent.

title: Neuromancer
author: William Gibson
description: A washed-up computer hacker is hired by a mysterious employer for one last job in cyberspace, where he encounters deadly AI and corporate intrigue.
quote: The sky above the port was the color of television, tuned to a dead channel.

title: Ender's Game
author: Orson Scott Card
description: Recruited at a young age to train at Battle School, Andrew Ender Wiggin is humanity's last hope against an alien invasion.
quote: The enemy's gate is down.

title: The Martian
author: Andy Weir
description: An astronaut is stranded on Mars and must use his ingenuity to survive until a rescue mission can reach him.
quote: I'm going to have to science the shit out of this.

title: Ready Player One
author: Ernest Cline
description: In a dystopian future, people escape into a virtual reality world called the OASIS, where a dead billionaire has hidden an Easter egg worth his fortune.
quote: People who live in glass houses should shut the fuck up.

author: George Orwell
description: In a totalitarian future society, a man works for the government falsifying historical records, until he begins to question the regime.
quote: War is peace. Freedom is slavery. Ignorance is strength.

title: Brave New World
author: Aldous Huxley
description: A dystopian novel where society is built on genetic engineering and psychological conditioning, and one man dares to question the system.
quote: Words can be like X-rays if you use them properly.

title: Fahrenheit 451
author: Ray Bradbury
description: In a future where books are banned and burned by firemen, one fireman begins to question his society and discovers the power of reading.
quote: You don't have to burn books to destroy a culture. Just get people to stop reading them.

title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
author: Douglas Adams
description: An ordinary man is swept off Earth moments before it is demolished to make way for a hyperspace bypass, beginning a journey through the universe.
quote: The Answer to the Great Question of Life, the Universe and Everything is 42.

title: Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?
author: Philip K. Dick
description: In a post-apocalyptic world, a bounty hunter is tasked with retiring six escaped androids — but begins to question the line between human and artificial life.
quote: Empathy, he once had decided, must be limited to herbivores or anyhow omnivores who could depart from a meat diet.

title: The Time Machine
author: H.G. Wells
description: A scientist invents a time machine and travels to the distant future, only to find that humanity has evolved into two very different species.
quote: Nature never appeals to intelligence until habit and instinct are useless.

title: The Left Hand of Darkness
author: Ursula K. Le Guin
description: An envoy from a future Earth visits a planet whose inhabitants are ambisexual — a thought-provoking exploration of gender, politics, and loyalty.
quote: The only thing that makes life possible is permanent, intolerable uncertainty.

title: Hyperion
author: Dan Simmons
description: Seven pilgrims travel to the world of Hyperion where the mysterious Shrike waits, each carrying a tale that may hold the key to humanity's future.
quote: There is no future without a past, because what is to be cannot be imagined except as a form of repetition.

title: The Hunger Games
author: Suzanne Collins
description: In a dystopian future, a teenage girl volunteers to take her sister's place in a televised death match between twenty-four young people.
quote: May the odds be ever in your favor.

title: Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea
author: Jules Verne
description: A mysterious sea monster terrorizing ships is tracked by a French marine scientist who finds himself aboard the legendary submarine Nautilus.
quote: The sea is everything. It covers seven tenths of the terrestrial globe.

title: Around the World in Eighty Days
author: Jules Verne
description: An English gentleman wagers that he can circumnavigate the world in just eighty days, racing against time on an incredible journey.
quote: Anything one man can imagine, other men can make real.

title: Treasure Island
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
description: A young boy finds a treasure map and sets sail to find the legendary hoard of the pirate Long John Silver, in a classic tale of adventure and treachery.
quote: Fifteen men on the dead man's chest — Yo-ho-ho, and a bottle of rum!

title: Robinson Crusoe
author: Daniel Defoe
description: Stranded alone on a tropical island after a shipwreck, Robinson Crusoe must use his ingenuity to survive and build a life on his island paradise.
quote: I have no other comfort but that I had a great reserve of patience.

title: The Count of Monte Cristo
author: Alexandre Dumas
description: A young sailor is falsely imprisoned and spends years plotting his escape and elaborate revenge against those who betrayed him.
quote: All human wisdom is contained in these two words: Wait and Hope.

title: The Three Musketeers
author: Alexandre Dumas
description: A young Gascon arrives in Paris to join the Musketeers of the Guard and becomes embroiled in the political intrigues of Cardinal Richelieu.
quote: All for one and one for all.

title: Call of the Wild
author: Jack London
description: A domesticated dog is stolen from his comfortable California home and taken to the frozen wilderness of the Yukon during the Klondike Gold Rush.
quote: There is an ecstasy that marks the summit of life, and beyond which life cannot rise.

title: The Jungle Book
author: Rudyard Kipling
description: A boy raised by wolves in the Indian jungle learns the laws of the jungle alongside his animal friends Baloo and Bagheera.
quote: The strength of the pack is the wolf, and the strength of the wolf is the pack.

title: Gulliver's Travels
author: Jonathan Swift
description: A ship surgeon travels to fantastical lands including the tiny Lilliputians and the giant Brobdingnagians in this satirical adventure classic.
quote: Whoever could make two ears of corn or two blades of grass to grow upon a spot of ground where only one grew before would deserve better of mankind.

title: The Adventures of Tom Sawyer
author: Mark Twain
description: A mischievous boy living on the Mississippi River goes on adventures with his friends, including witnessing a murder in the graveyard.
quote: A man is not old until regrets take the place of dreams.

title: White Fang
author: Jack London
description: The story of a wolf-dog's gradual domestication, following his journey from the harsh wilderness of the Yukon Territory to civilized life in the South.
quote: Life is not always a matter of holding good cards, but sometimes, playing a poor hand well.

title: The Old Man and the Sea
author: Ernest Hemingway
description: An aging Cuban fisherman struggles with a giant marlin in the Gulf Stream, in a tale of courage, endurance, and the dignity of the natural world.
quote: A man can be destroyed but not defeated.

title: Kidnapped
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
description: A young Scotsman is kidnapped and sold into slavery by his treacherous uncle, embarking on a wild adventure to reclaim his rightful inheritance.
quote: There are no foreign lands. It is the traveler only who is foreign.

title: The Wise Man's Fear
author: Patrick Rothfuss
description: Kvothe continues his story of becoming the most legendary man of his age, from his time at the University to his years in the courts of kings.
quote: There are three things all wise men fear: the sea in storm, a night with no moon, and the anger of a gentle man.

title: The Atlas Six
author: Olivie Blake
description: Six magicians are recruited by a secretive society that holds all the world's knowledge — but only five can be initiated, and one must be eliminated.
quote: Magic is the use of knowledge that other people don't have.

title: The Silence of the Lambs
author: Thomas Harris
description: An FBI trainee must seek the help of imprisoned serial killer Hannibal Lecter to catch another killer who skins his female victims.
quote: A census taker tried to test me once. I ate his liver with some fava beans and a nice Chianti.

title: Moby Dick
author: Herman Melville
description: Captain Ahab obsessively pursues the white whale that took his leg, in an epic tale of obsession, humanity, and the sea.
quote: Call me Ishmael.

title: Flowers for Algernon
author: Daniel Keyes
description: A mentally disabled man undergoes an experimental procedure that turns him into a genius, in a moving story about identity, intelligence, and what it means to be human.
quote: Even a feeble light is better than the darkness.

title: The Road
author: Cormac McCarthy
description: A father and his son walk alone through burned America, heading toward the coast while carrying the fire that keeps their hope alive.
quote: You have to carry the fire.

title: Never Let Me Go
author: Kazuo Ishiguro
description: Students at an idyllic English boarding school grow up never fully understanding the dark truth of what their futures hold.
quote: What I'm not sure about is if our lives have been so different from the lives of the people we save.

title: The Handmaid's Tale
author: Margaret Atwood
description: In the totalitarian society of Gilead, women are reduced to their reproductive function in this chilling speculative fiction classic.
quote: Nolite te bastardes carborundorum. Don't let the bastards grind you down.

title: tales of harry potter
author: cheakspear
description: tales of harry potter
